title: A comprehensive in silico analysis of the deleterious nonsynonymous SNPs of human FOXP2 protein.
authors: Akter, Mahmuda; Khan, Sumaiya Farah; Sajib, Abu Ashfaqur; Rima, Fahmida Sultana
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算工具和分子对接分析FOXP2转录因子错义SNP对蛋白-DNA结合界面的影响，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，但方法以传统计算预测为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: FOXP2 encodes the forkhead transcription factor that plays a significant role in language development. Single nucleotide polymorphisms in FOXP2 have been linked to speech- language disorder, autism, cancer and schizophrenia. So, scrutinizing the functional SNPs to better understand their association in disease is an uphill task. The purpose of the current study was to identify the missense SNPs which have detrimental structural and functional effects on the FOXP2 protein. Multiple computational tools were employed to investigate the deleterious role of non-synonymous SNPs. Five variants as Y531H, L558P, R536G and R553C were found to be associated with diseases and located at the forkhead domain of the FOXP2 protein. Molecular docking analysis of FOXP2 DNA binding domain with its most common target sequence 5'-CAAATT-3' predicted that R553C and L558P mutant variants destabilize protein structure by changing protein-DNA interface interactions and disruption of hydrogen bonds that may reduce the specificity and affinity of the binding. Further experimental investigations may need to verify whether this kind of structural and functional variations dysregulate protein activities and induce formation of disease.
abstract_zh: FOXP2编码叉头转录因子，在语言发展中扮演重要角色。FOXP2中的单核苷酸多态性已与言语-语言障碍、自闭症、癌症和精神分裂症相关联。因此，仔细审查功能性SNP以更好地理解其在疾病中的关联是一项艰巨任务。本研究旨在识别对FOXP2蛋白具有有害结构和功能影响的错义SNP。采用多种计算工具来探究非同义SNP的有害作用。发现五个变异体Y531H、L558P、R536G和R553C与疾病相关，并位于FOXP2蛋白的叉头结构域。FOXP2 DNA结合域与其最常见靶序列5'-CAAATT-3'的分子对接分析预测，R553C和L558P突变变异体通过改变蛋白-DNA界面相互作用和破坏氢键来 destabilize 蛋白质结构，这可能降低结合的特异性和亲和力。进一步的实验研究可能需要验证这种结构和功能变异是否失调蛋白质活性并诱导疾病形成。
